Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Indianapolis hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 18 Indianapolis hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 3, Vio.com at 3, Evendo at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Billabook.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1 and Super.com at 1. These are the Indianapolis rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Indianapolis hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 17% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 15% at Holiday Inn Indianapolis Carmel by IHG to 18% at Homewood Suites by Hilton Indianapolis Downtown IUPUI. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
